title: Virtual Reality Fire Evacuation Drill with Decision Logging
description: Places learners in a smoke-filled building where choices of exit are recorded, and produces a debrief showing hesitations, wrong turns and time to safety compared with a cohort average.

title: Spatial Audio Orientation Aid for Visually Impaired Users
description: Uses stereo sound cues from a headset and camera depth data to signal obstacles and doorways, and evaluates with volunteers how quickly they navigate a marked course compared with a cane alone.
